name: value
description: Current value. Pass `null` for an indeterminate (unknown-progress) bar.

name: size
description: Height of the bar (small, medium, large).

name: intent
description: Color intent (primary, secondary, success, warning, danger, neutral).

name: label
description: Accessible label for the progress bar. Required — the WAI-ARIA `progressbar` role mandates an accessible name. Also rendered as visible text above the bar.

name: showValue
description: Whether to show the formatted value (e.g. "72%") next to the label.

name: formatValue
description: Custom formatter for the displayed value and `aria-valuetext`. Receives the current numeric value. When omitted, base-ui's default percent format is used for the displayed value.
